title: AP2 v0.2 human not present: the agent closes user-signed open mandates
summary: The autonomous mode. The user signs open mandates with constraints and the agent public key in cnf, then leaves. Later the agent finds a fitting checkout, signs closed mandates with its own key, and verifiers check the chain (sd_hash), the checkout binding and every constraint.

steps.label: Set a shopping task
steps.detail: The user describes a task the agent should finish later, for example buying a tent under a price limit at one store.

steps.label: Request approval of open Mandate Content
steps.detail: The agent proposes open Checkout and Payment Mandates: constraints instead of exact values, plus its own public key. An open Checkout Mandate needs at least one checkout.line_items constraint, and an open Payment Mandate needs a payment.reference constraint.

failures.condition: A constraint type the verifier will not know is included
failures.outcome: Every verifier must fail it later with unresolved_constraint.

steps.label: Show the constraints; authenticate and get consent
steps.detail: The surface renders the limits the agent will act within and authenticates the user.

steps.label: Sign open mandates with user_sk
steps.detail: The surface signs both open mandates. The hash of the open Checkout Mandate goes into payment.reference of the open Payment Mandate, and the agent key goes into cnf so only that agent can use them. The specification recommends the shortest exp that still lets the agent finish.

steps.label: Return the open mandates; the user leaves
steps.detail: From here on the agent acts without the user.

steps.label: Build a cart autonomously
steps.detail: The agent shops through the commerce protocol for a checkout it believes fits the task.

steps.label: Signed checkout (checkout_jwt); mandate required
steps.detail: Same as in the human-present mode: the merchant signs the checkout and asks for a mandate.

steps.label: Select open mandates that fit
steps.detail: The agent picks the open mandates whose constraints the checkout meets. How it selects is out of scope. It must not create overlapping closed mandates from the same open mandate until it holds an error receipt for the previous one.

steps.label: Sign closed mandates with agent_sk
steps.detail: The agent signs closed Checkout and Payment Mandates as key-binding JWTs with the key named in cnf. The checkout_jwt hash links them, and sd_hash binds each to its open parent. It discloses only what the verifier needs.

steps.label: Present open and closed Payment Mandates
steps.detail: The Credential Provider verifies the chain, checks that the closed mandate keeps every value the open one fixed, evaluates each constraint and creates a token, possibly with the network.

failures.condition: The amount is outside payment.amount_range or the payee is not allowed
failures.outcome: Payment Receipt with status Error. The error the specification gives for a closed mandate that cannot be shown to meet the constraints is unresolved_constraint.

failures.condition: The closed mandate is not signed by the key in cnf, or sd_hash does not match

steps.label: Payment token
steps.detail: Issued only after the chain verifies.

steps.label: Token plus open and closed Checkout Mandates
steps.detail: The merchant checks the closed Checkout Mandate against the cart and evaluates every constraint in the open one, for example that each line item requirement is met without reusing an item.

failures.condition: A line item cannot be matched, or the merchant is not in checkout.allowed_merchants
failures.outcome: Checkout Receipt with error unresolved_constraint; the agent may bring the user back to approve a closed mandate.

steps.label: Initiate payment with the token and both hashes
steps.detail: The merchant passes the token, the checkout_jwt hash and the open Checkout Mandate hash.

steps.label: Payment Receipt
steps.detail: The processor verifies the Payment Mandates in the token and both bindings, then signs the receipt. It also goes to the Credential Provider and the network.

steps.label: Checkout Receipt
steps.detail: Signed by the merchant, referencing the hash of the closed Checkout Mandate.

steps.label: Store the tuple and narrow the open mandate
steps.detail: The agent stores the open mandate, the closed mandate and the receipt together, and reduces the open mandate's scope, often so it cannot be presented again. Budget and recurrence constraints allow bounded reuse.
